Explanation:  
The question asks about the wife of the founder of the city where the 2023 Tour de France started. Both the predicted and ground truth answers assume the city is Bilbao and that its founder is Diego López V de Haro. The Predicted Answer gives "María Díaz de Haro" as his wife, while the Ground Truth Answer gives "Violant of Castile." According to historical records, Diego López V de Haro was married to Violant of Castile, not María Díaz de Haro (who was a different family member). The substance and identity of the spouse in the Ground Truth Answer do not appear in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
